summary: Medicure Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 21, 2026, reporting its financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, and announcing a conference call scheduled for May 25, 2026. The filing covers operational highlights, revenue breakdowns for products ZYPITAMAG and AGGRASTAT, pharmacy segment performance, R&D spending for MC-1, and adjusted EBITDA. No transaction, strategic review, or special situation event is described; it is a routine quarterly update for a foreign private issuer.
